title: Pharmacy Network and Out-of-Network Footing of the Ridgecrest RxSecure Plans
content:
Each Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan is contracted with the number of pharmacies this record gives, of which the stated number carry preferred cost sharing, and each plan stands on its own footing for a fill dispensed outside that network.

| Plan | Pharmacies in the network | Network pharmacies carrying preferred cost sharing | Mail-order pharmacy benefit offered | Footing for a fill at an out-of-network pharmacy |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | 58400 | 12300 | no | covered in an emergency only, the member paying the difference |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | 58400 | 15800 | yes | covered in an emergency only, the member paying the difference |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | 61200 | 18400 | yes | covered in an emergency only, the member paying the difference |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | 61200 | 21100 | yes | covered in an emergency only, the member paying the difference |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | 64900 | 24600 | yes | covered at the standard retail cost share |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | 64900 | 27900 | yes | covered at the standard retail cost share |

Stated at a different granularity: the network itself widens in three steps across the range, from 58400 pharmacies on the two lowest plans to 61200 on the middle two and 64900 on the two highest, while the preferred count rises at every step, from 12300 to 27900. Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) is the one plan of the six that offers no mail-order pharmacy benefit. The two highest plans, Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) and Premier (PDP), are the two that cover an out-of-network fill at the standard retail cost share rather than only in an emergency.
